acceptance_binding.result: Each active obligation has exactly one bound Acceptance record.

non_active_context.result: No deferred or excluded obligations were supplied.

oracle_coverage.result: Acceptance expected, forbidden, and observable clauses preserve the corresponding active obligation semantics without relying on declaration or fixture existence as behavior proof.

red_binding.result: Every bound Acceptance has its declared RED intent(s), with each listed intent targeting that Acceptance and an appropriate failure family.

source_recall_gate.result: The supplied source explicitly supports the S7/S13 selectors, authoring-before-freeze constraints, fixture-role limits, exact metadata paths, snapshot exclusion, Windows support, platform declaration, and user-profile authority exclusion.
